tool.name: HumaninFinder
tool.description: Discovery tool for Humanin-like peptides using Hybrid AI
tool.command: humanin-finder predict --input '$input_fasta' --output 'analysis' --threshold $threshold --table $table $hmm $rescue $all_candidates && mv analysis_results.csv '$output_csv' && mv analysis_results.fasta '$output_fasta'
tool.help:
**HumaninFinder** is a Hybrid AI engine for the discovery of Humanin-like peptides. It combines ESM-2 structural embeddings with biophysical properties to identify functional, non-canonical, and pseudogenic sequences.
**Main Features:** - HMM-based locus localization. - Evolutionary Rescue mode for divergent peptides. - Biological redundancy filtering.
